desc:
Guns are prohibited in this city, forcing hoodlums, thugs, and gang members to pick up martial arts as their main weapon.

Welcome to Kampilan City, a Filipino street-life game where gangs fight for every block. Start or join a gang, spray your tag to claim turf, and lead turf wars against rival players and NPC gangs. Roll for fighting styles like Boxing, Capoeira and Karate and master their combos. Work jobs for cash, pickpocket and threaten civilians, and keep your heat low or the cops will come for you. Lose a fight and you could wake up in a coma.

YOU CAN CHANGE EVERY KEYBIND IN THE KEYBINDS MENU

M1 - Light
F - Heavy
R - Grab / Finisher
Hold M2 - Block
Q - Dash (twice to dodge)
Z - Lock on (Assisted combat)
Left Shift - Sprint
Left Ctrl - Shift lock

Kalye is in beta. Expect changes, fixes and new content as we build it out.
